name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 3 - Am 64
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 3a. Considers it crucial to ensure that the housing sector is predominantly centred on public, non-profit – with a particular focus on cooperative and community-led models – and limited-profit housing providers and is guided by legally binding conditionalities to ensure universal, long-term access to affordable, sustainable and decent housing in order to prevent housing from being managed as a financial asset or commodity, given that the right to adequate housing is an essential need and a fundamental human right, recognised in international human rights law as part of the right to an adequate standard of living; emphasises the paramount importance for a significant increase in and prioritization of public investment for social housing in order to have their considerable expansion; is strongly convinced that legally binding conditionalities to guarantee the permanent affordability, sustainability and public ownership of social housing must be set out;
